mapper.sql: SELECT r.room_id AS roomId,l.employee_code AS low,h.employee_code AS high,r.last_room_seq AS lastRoomSeq FROM chat_room r JOIN employee l ON l.employee_id=r.employee_low_id JOIN employee h ON h.employee_id=r.employee_high_id
mapper.select: WHERE r.room_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF r.last_room_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (employee_low_id,employee_high_id) SELECT l.employee_id,h.employee_id FROM employee l CROSS JOIN employee h WHERE l.employee_code=#{low} AND h.employee_code=#{high} AND l.employee_id < h.employee_id

INSERT INTO chat_read_state (room_id,employee_id,last_read_seq) SELECT r.room_id,r.employee_low_id,0 FROM chat_room r WHERE r.room_id=#{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.room_id,r.employee_high_id,0 FROM chat_room r WHERE r.room_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.room_id AS roomId,CASE WHEN l.employee_code=#{actor} THEN h.employee_code ELSE l.employee_code END AS otherEmployeeId,r.last_room_seq AS lastRoomSeq,s.last_read_seq AS lastReadSeq, (SELECT COUNT(m.message_id) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.room_id=r.room_id AND m.room_seq > s.last_read_seq AND m.sender_id <> s.employee_id) AS unreadCount FROM chat_room r JOIN employee l ON l.employee_id=r.employee_low_id JOIN employee h ON h.employee_id=r.employee_high_id JOIN chat_read_state s ON s.room_id=r.room_id WHERE s.employee_id=(SELECT employee_id FROM employee WHERE employee_code=#{actor}) ORDER BY (SELECT MAX(latest.created_at) FROM chat_message latest WHERE latest.room_id=r.room_id) DESC NULLS LAST,r.room_id DESC

SELECT roomSeq,senderEmployeeId,content FROM ( SELECT m.room_seq AS roomSeq,e.employee_code AS senderEmployeeId,m.message_text AS content FROM chat_message m JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id=m.sender_id WHERE m.room_id=#{id} AND (#{before}=0 OR m.room_seq < #{before}) ORDER BY m.room_seq DESC FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY ) ORDER BY roomSeq ASC

SELECT m.room_seq AS roomSeq,e.employee_code AS senderEmployeeId,m.message_text AS content FROM chat_message m JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id=m.sender_id WHERE e.employee_code=#{sender} AND m.client_request_id=#{key}
SELECT m.room_id FROM chat_message m JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id=m.sender_id WHERE e.employee_code=#{sender} AND m.client_request_id=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET last_room_seq=last_room_seq+1 WHERE room_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (room_id,room_seq,sender_id,client_request_id,message_text) SELECT #{id},#{seq},e.employee_id,#{key},#{content,jdbcType=CLOB} FROM employee e WHERE e.employee_code=#{sender}
mapper.select: SELECT last_read_seq FROM chat_read_state WHERE room_id=#{id} AND employee_id=(SELECT employee_id FROM employee WHERE employee_code=#{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_read_state SET last_read_seq=GREATEST(last_read_seq,#{seq}),read_at=SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE room_id=#{id} AND employee_id=(SELECT employee_id FROM employee WHERE employee_code=#{actor})
